prompt.content: You debug exergy ledgers of energy plants. A ledger computes the exergy flow E[x] (MW) of every stream x from its state values, and the exergy destruction ED[c] (MW) of every component c as the exergy of its inlet streams minus the exergy of its outlet streams minus the work it delivers. A correct ledger gives ED >= 0 for every component and closes: the sum of all ED equals the exergy entering at the boundaries minus the exergy leaving minus the net work. You are given the ledger, the topology, the values and the result. Answer with a short <diagnosis> citing only numbers shown (MW), then <fix> with at most 4 lines `FIX T0 = <expr>`, `FIX E[<stream>] = <expr>` or `FIX ED[<component>] = <expr>`. Expressions use numbers, + - * /, parentheses, T0, and lookups m[x], h[x], s[x], g0[x], ech[x], E[x], W[c]. Change only what is wrong.

LEDGER
T0 = 300.23840011962943
E[air] = m[air]*(h[air] - T0*s[air] - g0[air] + ech[air])/1e6
E[s2] = m[s2]*(h[s2] - T0*s[s2] - g0[s2] + ech[s2])/1e6
E[fuel] = m[fuel]*(h[fuel] - T0*s[fuel] - g0[fuel] + ech[fuel])/1e6
E[s4] = m[s4]*(h[s4] - T0*s[s4] - g0[s4] + ech[s4])/1e6
E[s5] = m[s5]*(h[s5] - T0*s[s5] - g0[s5] + ech[s5])/1e6
E[chw_ret] = m[chw_ret]*(h[chw_ret] - T0*s[chw_ret] - g0[chw_ret] + ech[chw_ret])/1e6
E[chw_sup] = (h[chw_sup] - T0*s[chw_sup] - g0[chw_sup] + ech[chw_sup])/1e6
E[cw_in] = m[cw_in]*(h[cw_in] - T0*s[cw_in] - g0[cw_in] + ech[cw_in])/1e6
E[cw_out] = m[cw_out]*(h[cw_out] - T0*s[cw_out] - g0[cw_out] + ech[cw_out])/1e6
ED[AC] = E[air] - E[s2] - W[AC]
ED[CC] = E[s2] + E[fuel] - E[s4]
ED[GT] = -E[s4] - E[s5] - W[GT]
ED[DC] = E[chw_sup] - E[chw_ret] - W[DC]
ED[CH] = E[chw_ret] + E[cw_in] - E[chw_sup] - E[cw_out] - W[CH]

AMBIENT T0_K=300.23840011962943

TOPOLOGY
AC compressor in: air out: s2
CC combustor in: s2 fuel out: s4
GT turbine in: s4 out: s5
DC dc_load in: chw_sup out: chw_ret
CH electric_chiller in: chw_ret cw_in out: chw_sup cw_out
BOUNDARY in: air fuel cw_in out: s5 cw_out

VALUES
air: m=105.3 h=-1.623e+05 s=6963 g0=-2.253e+06 ech=0
